title: Eidolon : Large scythes
description: A simple resource pack for Eidolon: Repraised that makes the scythes larger when you held it in hand
body:
A simple resource pack for Eidolon : Repraised that makes the scythes larger when you held in the hand, like scythes from Malum mod.
